sentences.text: Cada matí vaig al mateix cafè.
sentences.cue: Every morning I go to the same café.

sentences.text: Bon dia, voldria un cafè amb llet, si us plau.
sentences.cue: Good morning, I would like a coffee with milk, please.
I would also like a croissant.

sentences.text: I una aigua, si us plau.
Al final demano el compte i dic gràcies.
sentences.cue: At the end I ask for the bill and say thank you.

turns.speaker: learner
turns.cue: Say you would like a coffee with milk, please
accept: Voldria un cafè amb llet, si us plau

turns.speaker: cambrera
turns.text: Molt bé. Alguna cosa per menjar?

turns.speaker: learner
turns.cue: Say you would like a croissant, please
accept: Voldria un croissant, si us plau

turns.speaker: learner
turns.cue: Ask for a water as well
accept: I una aigua, si us plau

turns.speaker: learner
accept: Voldria el compte, si us plau

turns.speaker: learner
turns.cue: Say you would like a cortado, please
accept: Voldria un tallat, si us plau

turns.speaker: learner
turns.cue: Say no thank you, that is all

freeform.scenario: You work behind the counter of a busy café in Girona. The learner is a customer ordering breakfast. Take their order, offer them something to eat, tell them the price, and say goodbye. Stay on café ordering.
